project_title: German Credit Forensic Risk & Economic Exposure Analysis

cardinality_defense_plan.dimension_aggregation_strategies: Pre-aggregate categorical attributes (Saving accounts, Checking account, Purpose) into distinct reference tables using 'GROUP BY' to ensure 1:1 cardinality before joining to fact table. Nulls in accounts are mapped to 'unknown' to prevent join failure.
cardinality_defense_plan.entity_resolution_and_key_cleaning: Generate 'fact_surrogate_id' using UUID or auto-increment index from 'Unnamed: 0' to enforce strict 1:1 primary key identity. Strip whitespace from 'Risk' and 'Housing' strings; cast 'Job' to ordinal integer category.
cardinality_defense_plan.relational_join_sequence: Left Join (fact) -> Dim_Account_Status (on Checking/Saving codes); Left Join (fact) -> Dim_Demographic (on Age/Sex/Job); Left Join (fact) -> Dim_Contract (on Purpose/Duration/Amount).

assertion_gates: assert len(final_fact) == len(initial_fact), 'Row count mismatch: Cartesian duplicate explosion or row loss occurred!'
assert 'Risk' in final_fact.columns, 'Missing expected dimension features!'

dax_measures: Rate / Percentage % = DIVIDE([Target Events Count], [Total Volume / Records])
Segment Performance / Congestion Index = DIVIDE(SUM(fact_table[Credit amount]), AVERAGE(fact_table[Duration]))
